fair_value_reason: The round-2 agent fair values are $77-79 (mean $78), after all agents normalised capex (Q2 capex $34.3M, ~2% of sales), agent_2 fixed net debt ($0.595B) and cut its 19x multiple, and agent_4 dropped the Substack CY28 EPS. That is ~16.5-17.5x an NTM EPS of ~$4.5-5.0 and a ~5-5.5% yield on ~$1.6-2.0B normalised FCF. I found no further error, so I keep $78 (down from my round-1 $80), ~3% above spot.
supervisor_summary: All five forecasters took up the round-1 corrections (capex-normalised FCF, agent_2's net debt and 19x multiple, agent_4's Substack EPS) and converged: fair values $77-79, median ~$78, P(close >= $76 on 2027-09-29) ~0.52, thesis break ~$52. The only open dispute was the October FOMC odds, and agent_4 was right: hike odds fell from ~70% to ~44-51% on Sep 29-30 after NY Fed President Williams' remarks, so the Oct 28 meeting is a two-sided coin flip rather than a priced-in hike. That adds variance but no direction, so I keep the forecaster mean ladders at low confidence. ON is a fairly valued high-beta cyclical recovery (~16.8x CY27) with the Q3 print (~Nov 2) and the mid-2027 Synaptics close ahead.
key_drivers: Earnings recovery: Q2 2026 revenue $1,604M, non-GAAP EPS $0.74 above the guidance midpoint. Q3 guide $1.65-1.75B, 40-42% GM, $0.81-0.93 EPS. Consensus goes from CY26 $3.20 to CY27 $4.53, and ON trades ~16.8x CY27.
Normalised FCF: LTM FCF is flattered by trough capex (Q2 $34.3M, ~2% of sales). With capex at ~5%, 2027 FCF is ~$1.55-2.05B, which caps FCF-yield values at ~$75-80.
De-rating from the all-stock Synaptics deal (1.35x, 88/12 pro forma, close mid-2027) and back-loaded 2030 analyst-day targets (~$11B revenue, 53% GM).
SiC competition: Chinese wafers ~$400 vs ~$1,200 Western cost, and Czech job cuts. This is partly offset by two price increases in 2026, confirmed at the Aug 27 DB conference.

Rates: the Fed hiked in September. October hike odds fell from ~70% to ~44-51% on Sep 29-30 after Williams' remarks, with December now the likelier hike (~74%), so macro pressure on semi multiples is two-sided in the near term.
